author: Microsoft
name: .NET MAUI App
description: A project for creating a .NET MAUI application for iOS, Android, Mac Catalyst, WinUI and Tizen
postActions/restore/description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
symbols/Framework/description: The target framework for the project.
symbols/IncludeSampleContent/description: Configures whether to add sample pages and functionality to demonstrate basic usage patterns.
symbols/Linux/description: Adds a Linux head (GTK 4, net10.0-gtk4.22): Platforms/Linux/Program.cs and the Microsoft.Maui.Controls.Gtk package. Needs the GtkSharp 'gtk' workload; see src/Gtk/README.md.
symbols/mauiGtkVersion/description: The version of the Microsoft.Maui.* packages of the Linux head (a floating range of the GTK build).
symbols/skipRestore/description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the project on create.
